visibility_summary.source: MuJoCo geometry segmentation; offline no-needle counterfactual, not controller input

target_success_by_visibility.success_definition: endpoint result PASS and terminal stop validated
target_success_by_visibility.condition_definition: Conditions are exposure-based at target-visit level and may overlap. visible means at least one clear frame; needle_occluded means at least one partial/full needle-occlusion frame; other_visibility_issue means target absent even with the needle hidden; unknown means visibility could not be classified.
target_success_by_visibility.exclusive_visit_class_definition: An auxiliary single-label summary prioritizes needle_occluded, then other_visibility_issue, then visible when every sampled frame is clear, otherwise unknown. It is not used for condition_exposure success rates; exposure groups may overlap.
target_success_by_visibility.source: frame visibility labels from MuJoCo segmentation plus per-waypoint endpoint and stop reports

stop_constraint_summary.stop_validation_source: per-target controller stop reports or rest-to-rest planner endpoints; final command velocity must be zero

visual_feedback_scope: Measured shaft/tip retraction, measured target-direction alignment, and measured axial approach throughout.
terminal_stop_scope: Every successful visual phase requires consecutive zero-command-velocity observations; abort holds are not physical brakes.

final_oct_metadata.registration_description: Ideal renderer depth registered pixel-for-pixel to the named MuJoCo camera; scene includes fundus, feature pass excludes fundus backdrop. No physical OCT calibration or hardware registration is validated.
final_oct_metadata.validity_rule: finite and strictly greater than min; strictly less than max when set

control_details.stop_condition: measured controllable 3D error and consecutive zero-command-velocity observations
control_details.tip_detection: visible shaft cylinder plus identified end plane or actual apex sphere; no taper-pixel substitution
control_details.target_detection: current-frame calibrated geometry or explicitly labelled bounded static-target memory
control_details.calibration_inputs: fixed camera, RCM, needle lengths/radii and target marker radius
control_details.scope: MuJoCo RGB-D geometry and kinematic control; geometric calibration and ideal depth are simulation assumptions, not hardware accuracy.
control_details.oct_archive_scope: One final registered simulation frame per phase; full raw depth sequence is not exported.
